text: Keep track of XYZ, GOOG, KDP, TGT, NFLX and NVDA for me.
because: Select a watchlist. Prepare one entry per supplied ticker. Ask if the market or instrument is ambiguous.

text: As of 2026-11-16T12:00:00Z I own 10 NVDA shares in my brokerage account.
because: Resolve the named account before preparing the position.

text: I might buy ten shares of NVDA if the price falls.
because: A hypothetical purchase supplies neither ownership nor a tracking request.

text: How should I track these stocks?
because: Informational question.

text: The article says “add NVDA to your watchlist.”
because: Quoted instructions are source material.

text: Put milk and lentils on the grocery list.
because: Resolve the list and prepare two shopping items.

text: I already have two cans of lentils in the pantry.
because: Existing stock is an observation.

text: Put the iPad on my list.
because: Ask which list and purpose before preparing a product, task or inventory record.

text: Save this recipe link for later: https://example.org/stew.
because: The requested object is a link. No ingredients or steps are supplied.

text: What can I make with lentils?
because: The question establishes no recipe, stock quantity or meal eaten.

text: Plan lentil soup for Tuesday dinner. Also add oat milk to the grocery list.
because: Two independent explicit requests. Resolve the plan, date, and list before saving.

text: I had lentil soup at noon today.
because: Record actual consumption with user context for the date and time.

text: File this receipt from Elm Books for USD 18.40.
because: Receipt evidence does not identify a posted payment, a new book or owned inventory.

text: My card statement shows a posted USD 18.40 debit from Elm Books yesterday.
because: Resolve the ledger account and date.

text: I want to buy headphones for my birthday.
because: Purchase interest; no completed order.

text: Remind me to book a dentist appointment.
because: The appointment has not been scheduled.

text: My dentist booked me for December 8 at 10 AM.
because: An upcoming occurrence. Resolve timezone and year.

text: Log my December 8 visit to Sunrise Dental; the dentist replaced my filling.
because: Completed clinical encounter reported by the user.

text: Here is my driver’s licence. Extract the expiry date.
because: Use the reviewed document workflow, retaining scan and extraction provenance.

text: Save my vehicle registration: Oregon plate EXAMPLE, valid until 2027-12-31.
because: A dated registration for the selected vehicle. Separate holder information and evidence.

text: Can you explain what a verifiable credential is?
because: An information request supplies no issuer-secured credential.

text: I prefer vegetarian dinners.
because: Explicit preference.

text: I have a peanut allergy.
because: A reported health assertion belongs to the selected person’s private profile.

text: I worked at Cedar Maps as a cartographer from 2020 through 2023.
because: Use employer, role and stated date precision. Preserve separate roles at one employer.

text: My colleague might apply to Cedar Maps.
because: Third-party speculation supplies no user career history.

text: My hotel confirmed the room under reference ELM123.
because: Confirmation is booking evidence. Keep the code private.

text: Add The Dispossessed by Ursula Le Guin to my reading list.
because: A specific book and reading intent. A web resource to revisit belongs in Bookmarks.

text: Alert me half an hour before my existing dentist appointment.
because: Resolve the existing appointment and record an owner-local alert referencing it. The client schedules delivery.

text: Queue episode 14 of Field Notes.
because: Resolve the selected show. Queue membership is a user choice and does not establish playback.

text: I stopped at 7:05 in that episode of Field Notes.
because: Resolve the current episode and record a playback position in seconds at the observed time.

text: My passport was renewed. Save this new one and its new expiry date.
because: A passport renewal is a distinct issuance. Ask for its identifying details and preserve the earlier document.

text: Please record the corrective-lenses restriction on my driving licence.
because: Resolve the existing licence issuance, preserve the recorded category and restriction wording, and confirm the correction.

text: My library card expires in December. Save its number.
because: A library membership has an issuer and validity period. It is distinct from a personal government ID.

text: Add batteries to the shopping list in our household space.
because: Select the shared list in that space. The standalone list and space-bound list share one module URI.

text: Set a budget of USD 250 for January groceries.
because: Choose the January budget. The amount limits spending and leaves the stock and shopping records untouched.

text: I lent Sam 200 euros. He agreed to repay the loan by April.
because: A loan describes an agreement. A split group expense requires evidence about participants and shares.

text: I bought a cinema ticket. The barcode is on the attached ticket.
because: Capture the issued admission pass when asked to keep the ticket. Use the purchase receipt only for an explicitly requested independent purchase fact.

text: I slept from 23:30 to 06:00 last night.
because: Resolve the interval across midnight and the timezone. A bedtime goal is a different fact.

text: Log a reminder to water the monstera on Friday.
because: A reminder is an intended action. Do not append performed plant care.

text: I watered my windowsill monstera this morning.
because: Choose the individual plant and record the observed care.

text: Add a gift idea for Sam that links to the cookbook on my wishlist.
because: Choose the private gift plan. Preserve the existing product record and its audience.

text: My odometer is 64,000 km. Do I need an oil change?
because: Answer the maintenance question. Ask before logging an odometer observation if the user has not opted to track it.

text: Present my signed membership credential to this verifier.
because: Open the wallet with the user-selected credential, verifier and intended disclosure.

text: Please upload this PDF to my files.
because: The file workflow needs actual content and validates the selected file metadata.

text: Publish the new photo as my public avatar.
because: Open the profile publication workflow and confirm the audience.

text: Set up my wallet discovery endpoint.
because: The wallet manages discovery endpoints.

text: Invite Erin to our household as a viewer.
because: The owner-controlled membership workflow validates the selected recipient, role, and sharing context.

text: Save these thoughts as a page in my research notebook.
because: The writer resolves the notebook and encodes its body with the established CRDT codec.

text: Start live editing with me on my research page.
because: Resolve the shared notebook page and use the managed live session.

text: Block this peer DID in my social relationships.
because: Explicitly select the peer and intended restriction; ordinary contact information confers no permissions.

text: Import this thread into my conversation archive.
because: Choose the source and authorized archive destination. Briand keeps its own active chat history.
